page_title: ATM 2-1 ALA | Atletico Madrid v Alaves 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' 2 - 1 Goal! Ianis Hagi slips it to Ander Guevara (Alaves) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 2:1.
90+5' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+4' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+3' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
88' Alaves are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. The ball is out of play. Alaves will take a throw-in.
85' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
84' The substitution has been made. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) has replaced Antonio Blanco.
83' The referee shows a yellow card to Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
83' Javi Lopez sends a good ball to the edge of the box and Ianis Hagi (Alaves) gets in a shot which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
81' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
81' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) replacing Nahuel Molina.
81' That will be all from Mario Hermoso who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid).

80' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball would have probably ended inside the right post, if Antonio Sivera hadn't made a superb save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.
79' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
77' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
75' Dangerous play by Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid). Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

73' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time low shot towards goal from a promising distance, but Antonio Sivera denies him.
73' Substitution. Kike Garcia (Alaves) replaces Samu Omorodion.
71' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
71' The referee shows the yellow card to Ruben Duarte (Alaves).
71' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
71' The Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Alejandro Ruiz rules it out for a foul.
70' Andoni Gorosabel smashes in a cross, but Ianis Hagi (Alaves) finds it almost impossible to control and sends his header high over the bar from close in.
68' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is replacing Rodrigo de Paul.
67' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) replaces Alvaro Morata.
66' Flag up against Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
65' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement.
63' Substitution. Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) on for Luis Rioja.
63' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Jon Guridi is replaced by Ianis Hagi (Alaves).
62' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
58' Saul Niguez goes off the pitch and Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
58' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
57' Now Alaves have a corner.
57' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Alaves force a corner. They send men into the box.
56' A pass from Jon Guridi (Alaves) is intercepted by Jan Oblak and the move breaks down.
54' Alaves are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
50' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 7:6.
49' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
48' The attendance for today's match is 50009.
46' Luis Garcia Plaza makes a switch. Javi Lopez (Alaves) is coming on in place of Alex Sola at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+1' 2 - 0 Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Antonio Sivera is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 2:0.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Alaves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

44' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jan Oblak intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner.
43' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
42' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
41' The linesman raises his flag. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.

38' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Antonio Sivera to get hold of the ball.
34' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
32' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle and it's Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

26' 1 - 0 Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) meets a perfect cross from Alvaro Morata deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 1:0.
25' Jon Guridi (Alaves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
20' An accurate cross picks out Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
17' The Atl. Madrid players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
13' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

13' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) dribbles into the box, but Antonio Sivera is quick enough to come off his line and stop him. Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

9' The corner lands on the head of Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post.
9' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner.
9' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Atl. Madrid will take a corner kick.

6' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Antonio Sivera guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
4' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Ruiz signals a set piece.
3' The free kick is taken by Luis Rioja (Alaves), but ball is cleared.
2' The referee blows his whistle as Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge. Alaves win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
1' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Alaves will kick the game off.
Alejandro Ruiz got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
